2607.16705.title: OFD-Net: Teacher-Free Reliable Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation with Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Net of Foreground-Background
2607.16705.paper_summary: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) is an effective solution for medical image segmentation with limited annotations. Existing SSL methods mainly rely on pseudo-labels generated by teacher-student supervision or cross-network consistency. However, these methods lack an explicit structural reference for judging pseudo-label quality. Low-quality pseudo-labels may lead to unreliable training, error accumulation and confirmation bias when processing unlabeled data with substantial appearance variations. To address this issue, we proposed OFD-Net, a teacher-free single-network framework for reliable semi-supervised medical image segmentation. OFD-Net employs an Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Module (OFDM) to capture OFD features for reliable SSL by disentangling unlabeled data into background and foreground representations with a reliable structural distribution, thereby effectively reducing error accumulation and alleviating confirmation bias among unlabeled data. Specifically, OFD-Net explicitly employs a Disentanglement Guidance Module (DGM) to inject the resulting structural priors of foreground-background into the decoder by deformable convolution processing, and outputs predictions with clearer foreground representations. Based on DGM and the OFDM, we further develop a reliability-aware pseudo-label learning mechanism that evaluates unlabeled supervision according to the structural consistency between the main prediction and the disentangled foreground-background responses, and then down-weights unreliable regions during training. Extensive experiments on four public medical image segmentation benchmarks, namely ISIC-2016, Kvasir-SEG, Synapse, and ACDC, validate the effectiveness of OFD-Net. These results confirm that orthogonal foreground-background disentanglement enables OFD-Net to establish an efficient and reliable training paradigm within a teacher-free single-network framework.
2607.16705.paper_summary_zh: 半監督學習（SSL）是一種有效的解決方案，用於具有有限標註的醫學影像分割。現有的SSL方法主要依賴於由教師-學生監督或跨網絡一致性生成的偽標籤。然而，這些方法缺乏一個明確的結構參考來判斷偽標籤的質量。低質量的偽標籤可能導致不可靠的訓練、錯誤累積和在處理具有顯著外觀變化的未標註數據時的確認偏誤。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了OFD-Net，一種無教師的單網絡框架，用於可靠的半監督醫學影像分割。OFD-Net採用正交特徵解耦模塊（OFDM）來捕捉OFD特徵，以通過將未標註數據解耦為具有可靠結構分佈的背景和前景表示來實現可靠的SSL，從而有效減少錯誤累積並減輕未標註數據之間的確認偏誤。具體而言，OFD-Net明確地使用解耦指導模塊（DGM）通過可變形卷積處理將前景-背景的結構先驗注入解碼器，並輸出具有更清晰前景表示的預測。基於DGM和OFDM，我們進一步開發了一種可靠性感知的偽標籤學習機制，根據主要預測與解耦的前景-背景響應之間的結構一致性來評估未標註的監督，然後在訓練過程中對不可靠區域進行降權。在四個公共醫學影像分割基準上進行的廣泛實驗，即ISIC-2016、Kvasir-SEG、Synapse和ACDC，驗證了OFD-Net的有效性。這些結果確認了正交前景-背景解耦使OFD-Net能夠在無教師的單網絡框架內建立高效且可靠的訓練範式。
